articles.title: CleanSpark weighs selling more Bitcoin than it mines to ‘de-risk’ books
articles.snippet: The Bitcoin miner sold 2,102 BTC while it produced just 1,708 BTC in the September quarter.

articles.title: Justice Department Moves to Forfeit $1.1B in USDC From North Korea's Binance Hack
articles.snippet: U.S. authorities say they've now helped freeze, seize or return more than $2.9 billion of the crypto stolen from Binance in October.

articles.title: GTA 6 PC Ports ‘Nuked’ Just Days Before Devs Expected It to Be Playable
articles.snippet: Leonida and GTA6Modding went dark a day after Cyberleek released the executable file that porters had been waiting for.

articles.title: Tom Lee Says Ethereum Is as Scarce as Bitcoin—And Bitmine Just Bought More
articles.snippet: Chairman Tom Lee argued ETH’s supply has grown just 0.90% annually since mid-2025—roughly matching Bitcoin’s 0.82% and far below Solana, XRP and Cardano.
